- `style.css`: Responsive layout and game styling.
- `game.js`: Current game implementation; incomplete at file end.

## Objective
- Complete a playable fighting game based on the request for a Mortal Kombat-style matchup featuring Michael Jackson and LeBron James.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For checks, save a small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based canvas game titled “LEGENDS: ICON CLASH,” with an arena, character selection, keyboard and touch controls, CPU opponent, and optional two-player mode.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game page and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Drafted portions of canvas rendering and game mechanics in `game.js`.

### Active
- Rebuild/complete `game.js`: its current contents only define `overlay()` and `draw()` and depend on many missing declarations and functions.
- Add input handlers, animation loop, menu/start, pause, rematch, character selection, and two-player mode.
- Validate the game in a browser and capture/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- The game cannot run until the missing parts of `game.js` are restored or reimplemented.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` and implement a complete self-contained game script; previous `node --check game.js` reported `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'`, but it predates the current contents.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and test menu, controls, combat, pause, and rematch in a browser.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Incomplete current game implementation; currently contains only `overlay()` and `draw()`.
- `index.html`: Canvas game page, sound button, touch controls, and HUD shell.
- `style.css`: Responsive game layout and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local `python3 -m http.server 3002` was started but timed out; its current status is unknown.
- No screenshot has been captured.
